entities.name: Pavol Országh Hviezdoslav
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pavol Országh Hviezdoslav was a Slovak poet, dramatist, translator, and for a short time, member of the Czechoslovak parliament. Originally, he wrote in a traditional style, but later became influenced by parnassism and modernism.
